<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-09-0702-01-59" status="unreviewed">yang na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> na re gzhi la bkag pa'i ldog khyab kyis rjes 'gro mi 'phen yang <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i mtshan nyid du gyur pa'i rjes 'gro de nyid kyi ldog khyab 'phen te du ba yod pa la me yod pas khyab pa'i <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i mtshan nyid du gyur pa'i rjes 'gro nges pas shugs la me med pa la du ba med pas khyab pa'i <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i mtshan nyid du gyur pa'i ldog khyab 'phen pas so ||
            de bzhin du <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i ldog khyab kyis rjes 'gro 'phen pa la dgongs pa yin pa srid do gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
